operations.document: query ($berth_class: String, $occupied_flag: Int, $offset: Int, $limit: Int) { r: listBerths(berth_class: $berth_class, occupied_flag: $occupied_flag, offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { berth_id: berthId berth_class: berthClass occupied_flag: occupiedFlag max_mass_kg: maxMassKg current_docking_id: currentDockingId } }

occupied_flag.description: 0 or 1 — booleans were added to the schema language after this system shipped

operations.document: query ($berth_id: String, $status_code: String, $offset: Int, $limit: Int) { r: listDockings(berth_id: $berth_id, status_code: $status_code, offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { docking_id: dockingId berth_id: berthId vessel_registry_no: vesselRegistryNo eta_utc: etaUtc departed_utc: departedUtc status_code: statusCode } }

query ($docking_id: Int, $hazard_class: String, $offset: Int, $limit: Int) { r: listManifestLines(docking_id: $docking_id, hazard_class: $hazard_class, offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { line_id: lineId docking_id: dockingId sku description qty declared_mass_kg: declaredMassKg hazard_class: hazardClass } }

query ($operator_name: String, $offset: Int, $limit: Int) { r: listVessels(operator_name: $operator_name, offset: $offset, limit: $limit) { vessel_registry_no: vesselRegistryNo vessel_name: vesselName operator_name: operatorName max_capacity_kg: maxCapacityKg } }

query ($accountType: String, $standing: String, $cursor: String, $pageSize: Int) { r: listAccounts(accountType: $accountType, standing: $standing, cursor: $cursor, pageSize: $pageSize) { meta { cursor hasMore } } h: accounts { accountId displayName accountType standing balanceCents currency } }

query ($dockingRef: String, $accountId: String, $status: String, $cursor: String, $pageSize: Int) { r: listCharges(dockingRef: $dockingRef, accountId: $accountId, status: $status, cursor: $cursor, pageSize: $pageSize) { meta { cursor hasMore } } h: charges { chargeId dockingRef accountId chargeType amountCents currency status } }

query ($manifestLineRef: String, $dockingRef: String, $cursor: String, $pageSize: Int) { r: listValuations(manifestLineRef: $manifestLineRef, dockingRef: $dockingRef, cursor: $cursor, pageSize: $pageSize) { meta { cursor hasMore } } h: valuations { valuationId manifestLineRef declaredValueCents currency insuranceClass } }

query ($merchantId: String, $status: String, $cursor: String, $pageSize: Int) { r: listSettlements(merchantId: $merchantId, status: $status, cursor: $cursor, pageSize: $pageSize) { result { settlementId merchantId periodStart periodEnd grossCents feeCents netCents status } meta { cursor hasMore } } }

query ($crewRef: String, $status: String, $cursor: String, $pageSize: Int) { r: listPayroll(crewRef: $crewRef, status: $status, cursor: $cursor, pageSize: $pageSize) { result { payrollId crewRef periodEnd grossCents status } meta { cursor hasMore } } }
